preconditions.description: The number of lines n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= x <= 100000 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a contains exactly n integers, each between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.
The start and end line numbers are valid indices within the range [1, n].
The start and end column positions are valid for their respective lines (1 to length+1).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of key presses.

postconditions.expression: min_moves == min(abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) if r1 == r2 else min(abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2), abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - min(c1, a[r1-1] + 1)) + abs(min(c1, a[r1-1] + 1) - c2) if r1 < r2 else abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - min(c1, a[r1-1] + 1)) + abs(min(c1, a[r1-1] + 1) - c2)) if r1 != r2 else abs(c1 - c2))
postconditions.description: The value is the minimum distance calculated by considering direct movement or movement constrained by line lengths when changing lines, effectively finding the shortest path in the grid where vertical movement clamps the column to the target line's length.
